# ArtistGrid

ArtistGrid is a community-driven tracker for unreleased, leaked, and upcoming music from hundreds of artists. Browse artist discographies, open tracker sheets, and discover new music.

## Explore

- [Home](https://artistgrid.cx/)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/ArtistGrid)
- [Discord](https://discord.gg/YuwTae6QC4)

## Track an artist

Search for any artist on the homepage to view their tracker sheet, recent leaks, and release history.
